name: Applicant Name
whatItMeans: The full legal name of the person applying for the No Property Certificate.
whatToEnter: Enter your full name as recorded in official government ID proofs like Aadhaar or Voter ID.

name: Father's or Husband's Name
whatItMeans: The name of the applicant's father or husband for familial identification.
whatToEnter: Enter the complete name of your father or husband.

name: Gender
whatItMeans: The biological or recorded gender of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Select your appropriate gender from the available options (Male, Female, Other).

name: Date of Birth
whatItMeans: The chronological age or birth date of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

name: Age
whatItMeans: The completed years of age of the applicant as of the current date.
whatToEnter: Enter your current age in numbers.

name: Applicant Address
whatItMeans: The current residential location details of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Enter your complete residential address including house number, street, locality, district, and pincode.

name: Contact Details
whatItMeans: The telephone or mobile number used for official communication and updates regarding the application.

name: Aadhaar Number
whatItMeans: The unique 12-digit identification number issued by UIDAI to residents of India.

name: Purpose of Certificate
whatItMeans: The official reason or scheme for which the No Property Certificate is required.
whatToEnter: Specify clearly why you need the No Property Certificate (e.g., bank loan, welfare scheme, legal requirement).

name: Details of Family Members
whatItMeans: Information regarding the dependents or family members associated with the applicant.
whatToEnter: Provide the names and relationship details of your family members as applicable.

name: Delivery Type
whatItMeans: The preferred mode of receiving the final certificate (e.g., manual or direct download via MeeSeva).
whatToEnter: Select your preferred delivery mode for the certificate.
